source_tamil_lines: மிக—ஏழை எளிய எங்க மனசு குளிர இந்த
புது—மனமே தருமா மலரே இதுதான் நீயே பார்
english_lines: Come by this hut, so that our very poor, humble hearts
May be gladdened!—(ஓ)
O beautiful queen!
Will you grant a new heart, O flower? Look—this is you;
O flower, this is you—look.
A pair of roof-pigeons!
Never parting, upon the rooftop,
See how they sing, joined by desire!......Ah......
Do not desire me, sir;
This queen will be angry with you.
Isn't desire for another woman wicked?
Look at the queen, like a rose......
Moustached Raja—such slyness!
Do not, sir, out of useless greed;
Do not deceive—wouldn't that be wrong!
Youth never stays forever;
Think no evil, my precious hero!
Even if you wander through every town,
Can you ever see beauty anywhere like Amma's,
Sir?
Oh......Raja, may you always live happily together!
notes: `அம்மா` is retained as `Amma` because the performance address is culturally loaded and the source does not require a single normalized English identity.
The unusual `புது—மனமே தருமா மலரே...` wording is translated conservatively without repairing the Tamil.

translator_notes: The playful address, village imagery, moral teasing and repeated Raja/Rani framing are retained.
Item-level lyric authorship remains unresolved at this booklet-evidence tier; translation does not upgrade attribution.
